$comment: Provenance + integrity manifest for the ONNX Runtime native library the search binary loads at runtime (ort load-dynamic). Under Opt-1 of the dependency-security hardening, ll-search/ll-core build with ort's load-dynamic feature instead of download-binaries: this removes openssl/native-tls/ureq and the cdn.pyke.io fetch from the build graph, and the runtime dynamically loads an official Microsoft libonnxruntime. The library is fetched and SHA-256-verified at runtime (native/crates/ll-core/src/dylib.rs), staged under ~/.learning-loop/lib, or supplied by the operator via ORT_DYLIB_PATH. To upgrade, bump the ort crate, set version to the version ort pins (ort-sys dist.txt `ms@<version>`), and refresh the per-target SHA-256 hashes from the GitHub release.

runtime.role: ONNX inference engine (loaded via ort load-dynamic)

unsupported.x86_64-apple-darwin: Microsoft ships no osx-x64 binary for 1.24.2 (Intel macOS dropped). Such a host must set ORT_DYLIB_PATH to a self-provided libonnxruntime.
